hypothesis: A zero-extra-forward inference repair can raise CF++ 1-step full-video quality while preserving the measured one-H100 performance contract.

baseline.decoder: madebyollin/taehv taew2_1.pth, rolling three-latent context; block 0 trims 3 RGB frames, later blocks trim prior_context_latents*4; separate CUDA stream
baseline.historical_latency_caveat: The field name measured_first_visible_rgb_s records a post-TAEHV CUDA event, not CPU payload readiness or browser presentation; the historical runner copied pixels to CPU only after the complete rollout.
baseline.historical_quality_caveat: The three-prompt cf1_p*.mp4 suite was decoded with one full batch TAEHV call, not the rolling streaming decoder; it is development evidence only and does not close the exact-stack gate.

sf4-reference.decoder: Stock Wan2.1 VAE from the pinned Self-Forcing environment
sf4-reference.runner: historical SF4 generation script recovered from the session database
sf4-reference.historical_caveat: Only the source commit, recovered runner, and three old development media files are locally pinned. Exact checkpoint revision/hash, config hashes, and Wan decoder revision/hash must be recovered or regenerated before freeze.

repair_candidates.rationale: The pinned causal pipeline constructs its inference scheduler from model_kwargs.timestep_shift; guidance_scale and negative_prompt are not read on this path.
Symmetric adjacent scheduler perturbation around the released value 5.0, with no added model call.
Small registered input-noise perturbation that preserves step count and runtime.
Symmetric input-noise control; the exact pre-scaled tensor hash and scalar are both recorded.

changes.prompt_suffix: Single continuous shot. Preserve subject identity, anatomy, object geometry, and background throughout; render smooth physically coherent motion with stable camera continuity.

repair_candidates.rationale: Deterministic prompt conditioning supported by the released text path, evaluated for adherence against the original prompt.

excluded_controls: guidance_scale and negative_prompt: present in the training config but unused by CausalInferencePipeline
extra denoising steps or CF++ 2-step: contradicted by current quality/performance evidence
TAEHV, overlap, precision, compile, resolution, and context-trim changes: outside this quality-only sweep
seed search or best-of-N: changes the latency/product contract and invites cherry-picking

round_b.evaluate: Re-evaluate at most two Round-A survivors on both registered seeds and advance exactly one finalist. No post-hoc combination is permitted unless it is added as a registered candidate before protocol freeze.

development.no_survivor_rule: Stop inference tuning. Draft a bounded training/self-rollout repair proposal; do not broaden the knob grid.

confirmatory.lock_rule: The finalist and all generation/evaluation code are frozen before any confirmatory video is generated.

prompts.text: A lone red fox runs through a snowy pine forest at sunrise, cinematic tracking shot, realistic fur, stable anatomy.
A woman in a yellow raincoat walks toward the camera through a neon-lit Tokyo street after rain, natural face and hands, cinematic realism.
A vintage red motorcycle speeds along a winding coastal highway at golden hour, low tracking camera, stable wheels and mechanical details.
On a Moroccan rooftop, a woman in a turquoise kaftan pours mint tea from a silver pot into a small glass, then passes the glass to a seated friend as the camera holds on their hands.
A red passenger train crosses a high stone viaduct in the Swiss Alps while the camera tracks alongside, preserving the arches, carriages, and snowy mountain geometry.
A street chef flips noodles in a steel wok, flame flaring and steam curling upward, then sprinkles herbs as the camera pushes close to the food and fast hands.
Inside a robotics lab, an engineer plugs a cable into a humanoid arm, checks two diagnostic lights, and presses a start button while the camera circles slowly.
A violinist in a dark coat plays a quick phrase on a lantern-lit winter street, with clear bow contact, stable fingers, and a natural face as snow falls.
A golden retriever runs beside a shallow forest stream and leaps over a fallen log, landing naturally and continuing toward the camera in one shot.
A chestnut horse gallops across a green field at dawn while a side-tracking camera keeps its body, legs, mane, and shadow coherent.
A skateboarder rolls through a sunny concrete park, lands one clean kickflip, and rides away as the low camera tracks the board, trucks, and spinning wheels.
A black steam locomotive pulls six red carriages across a curved bridge, its wheels and connecting rods moving consistently as smoke trails backward.
A mother bird feeds three chicks in a nest, placing food into one open beak while the other chicks move naturally and remain distinct.
Two basketball players run down an outdoor court, exchange one chest pass, and continue toward the hoop while remaining distinct through the crossing motion.
A drone makes a smooth half-orbit around a white lighthouse on a rocky island while waves break below and the tower and horizon remain geometrically stable.
A skier in a crimson jacket carves a wide S-turn through powder as a low camera follows, keeping the mountain ridge and tree line continuous.
A bartender pours clear sparkling water from a glass bottle into a tumbler with ice, showing a continuous stream, bubbles, splashes, and stable hands.
A dancer turns once on a windy rooftop while a long red silk scarf curls around her body and settles naturally without changing shape or color.
A red fox runs along a winding forest trail in one continuous tracking shot, occasionally looking toward the camera while its identity and gait remain stable.
A rider on a red motorcycle travels continuously through a rainy city at night while the camera follows from the side and the rider, wheels, reflections, and street geometry remain stable.

evaluation.blinding_secret_policy: After the protocol is frozen, generate exactly 32 random bytes into an untracked operator-only file. Use keyed blinding and record only the secret SHA-256 in the unblinding key; never expose the secret, source filenames, or system IDs to judges.

families.raw_response_policy: Use one inline MP4 per request with explicit 16 fps sampling, temperature 0, and the registered structured schema. Persist canonical scrubbed safety metadata, request/media/rubric bindings, raw response, and response hash under bench/schemas/quality-google-model-evidence-v1.schema.json. Two-pass exact-byte transport calibration is complete, but full-plan fan-out remains blocked until a preregistered nine-video human-anchored calibration qualifies the family.
Use synchronous full-video structured analysis. Persist the scrubbed request binding, raw response, finish reason, usage, and media hash; never persist or expose the API key or base64 media.

Process-attested blind human ratings. Hash binding proves report-to-rating custody consistency, not cryptographic proof of independent human origin; operator roster and collection controls remain required.

evaluation.aggregation: Treat repeated deterministic passes within one model family as repeatability checks, not independent judgments. Average passes and raters within each family first; average prompt/seed cases within family; then equal-weight the independent families.

stop_rules: Stop before tuning if the archived baseline cannot be reproduced at exactly 45 forwards and 81 frames.
Stop if prompt+seed does not reproduce the committed initial-noise hash.

Stop if three warm baseline trials drift more than 3 percent from 31.039 fps or the post-TAEHV GPU-RGB CUDA event drifts more than 10 percent from 0.242 seconds without explanation; this historical event is not CPU-ready or browser-visible latency.
Stop automated screening if the two model families disagree on at least two of the six registered development prompts or differ by more than 1.0 point on CF1 mean.
Stop after Round B if no candidate passes; do not expand into decoder, KV-ring, SageAttention, FP8, compile, or generic extra-step work.
Stop the H100 session at 120 minutes or 6 USD, whichever comes first.
